ai_policy: AIAS Level 3 (AI Collaboration) for the report only; Part A is supervised with no AI.
context: In the Week 10 lab, each student receives a unique dataset generated from their student ID (campus canteen transactions, 6 months). The dataset is not available before or outside the lab.

tasks.text: T1 (40 marks) Part A, supervised in the Week 10 lab (no AI): clean your dataset and produce the three required summary figures. Your notebook is submitted at the end of the lab.

T2 (40 marks) Part B, report (take-home): using YOUR dataset's results from Part A, identify two patterns in canteen demand and recommend changes to opening hours or stock. Every claim must cite a value from your own Part A notebook.

T3 (20 marks) A 5-minute recorded walkthrough of your Part A notebook, in which you also make one change requested on the day of recording (the change is emailed to you when you start the recording window).
